message.content:
Based on the screenshot, here is a precise description of the desktop application interface:

### **Overall Layout**
The application window is divided into a **sidebar** on the left and a **main content area** on the right. The interface appears to be an AI coding assistant or development environment (likely Cursor or VS Code with an AI extension).

---

### **1. Top Menu Bar**
*   **Left:** Navigation arrows (back/forward), followed by menu items: **"File"**, **"Edit"**, **"View"**, **"Help"**.
*   **Right:** Search icon, notification bell, and standard window controls (minimize, maximize, close).

### **2. Left Sidebar (Navigation)**
This panel contains several collapsible sections:

*   **Primary Actions:**
    *   **"+ New chat"**
    *   **"Repository"**
    *   **"Pull requests"**
    *   **"Plugins"**
    *   **"Workflows"**

*   **Workspace Section:**
    *   Heading: **"Workspace"**
    *   **"Projects & tasks"**
    *   **"Reusable workflows"**
    *   **"Artifacts"**
    *   **"Activity"**

*   **Projects Section:**
    *   Heading: **"Projects"** (with a "+" icon)
    *   **"seed-ws"** (with folder icon, plus, link, and kebab menu icons)
    *   **"Untitled task"** (with radio button icon selected, label **"now"**) — *This item is highlighted in light blue.*

*   **Chats Section:**
    *   Heading: **"Chats"** (with search and refresh icons)
    *   Text: **"No chats"**

*   **Bottom Tools:**
    *   **"Terminal"**
    *   **"Browser"**
    *   **"Settings"**
    *   Status indicator: **"App-server online"** (with a green dot)

---

### **3. Main Content Area (Right Panel)**
This area displays details for the selected "Untitled task".

*   **Header:**
    *   Title: **"Untitled task"**
    *   Subtitle/path: **"/tmp/d10-seed-ws"**
    *   Action buttons: **"Commit or push"** (highlighted), **"Fork"**, **"Refresh Git"**, **"Changes"**, **"Outputs"**, **"Browser"**, **"Terminal"**, **"Computer"**, and **"..."** (more options).

*   **Tab Bar:**
    *   Tabs visible: **"Context"**, **"Agents"**, **"Environments"**, **"Evidence"**, **"More"**

*   **Task Configuration Details:**
    *   **"Model: not chosen yet"** (with a robot/model icon)
    *   **"* Capabilities"** followed by text: *"What a task can do — and what's missing when it can't"*
    *   **"☆ Save as a reusable workflow"** followed by text: *"Flauz can remember the successful steps so you can run them again"*

*   **Center Area:**
    *   A large black **"X"** icon is displayed in the middle of the screen.
    *   Bottom right text overlay: **"Wave 3 gate anchor task"**

*   **Input Area (Bottom):**
    *   A text input box with placeholder text: **"Ask Codex to change, inspect, or explain..."**

---

### **4. Status Bar / Toast Notification (Bottom)**
Yes, there is a prominent status toast/notification bar at the very bottom of the main content area, just above the window edge.

*   **Message (verbatim):** **"Codex hit an error and is retrying."**
*   **Action Button:** **"Dismiss"** (aligned to the right).
